desc.description: If true, the results are sorted in descending order.

end.description: Returns snapshots with timestamps earlier than this time.

sort.description:
Specifies the sort field for the requested snapshots. By default, the
snapshots are sorted by their timestamp.

start.description: Returns snapshots with timestamps after this time.

from.description: Skips the specified number of snapshots.

size.description: Specifies the maximum number of snapshots to obtain.

job_id.description: Identifier for the anomaly detection job.

snapshot_id.description:
A numerical character string that uniquely identifies the model snapshot. You can get information for multiple
snapshots by using a comma-separated list or a wildcard expression. You can get all snapshots by using `_all`,
by specifying `*` as the snapshot ID, or by omitting the snapshot ID.
